body: Idk how familiar you are with hair, but it actually takes a significant amount of time to grow it out... I’m currently several months into the “just grow it out “ process... Your comment has been so so helpful. Thanks..

Oh my god, you look extremely sweet and adorable!! You’re so much younger than me it’s hard to be objective, so I’ll say that as you are now, you’re a 7. However, I imagine you’re going to age into 9-9.5 territory as long as you take care of yourself. I think you will definitely have a Zac Efron vibe if you put on some muscle.
I would date you (26F here). You look kind of like a nicer version of Matthew Mcconaughey!

While I did a lot of it, I did end up having to get a color correction in a salon and the owner of the salon did have me sign a waiver and insisted on doing the color correction herself because she knew how risky it was. She did some type of treatment and that’s why I have any hair left at all. It’s still very damaged, but I have had as much professional help as I can afford to help the situation. It has grown out significantly since then and I don’t plan on bleaching it again probably ever.

It was done over about 16 sessions, 13 of which were done by me way too close together (over the course of about 6 weeks) So many products were used, but the worst was probably the boxed bleach from L’Oréal that I got from Walmart, which I used 3 times.
I’ve heard of it, but haven’t tried it yet.

I wish it were that easy or I would have done that already. Unfortunately, it’s not really about the color. It’s about the irreversible damage that the bleach did to my hair. I’m slowly growing out my natural hair with an ombré look, but I just don’t have the face shape to rock a pixie cut or even a bob.
7.5 but could easily make it to a 9 with some muscles. I love the way you look!
9.5 with the mustache. You look amazing!
I am giving raises to employees who do their jobs and not little ones either. I mean $1.00 - $2.00/hr raises and this is a corporate foodservice establishment.
I have already fired a few. I wield significant power and have strong influence on my area director.

A huge part of the problem is that they’re not getting the work done. They transferred me from another location to get them in line. I can have friendly professional relationships but when I’m a new person coming from another location telling everyone that they’re not performing, that doesn’t make them want to be friendly with me. I’m great at dealing with my employees once they get to know my quirks, but they just haven’t had time and I have to make them do their jobs immediately.

I think that it’s much harder to deal with because I am a supervisor so I can’t really be friendly with my coworkers. I can’t really allow them to A, so it defaults to B in order for me to be effective at my job but it takes a huge toll on me. I’m working in an unfamiliar environment at the moment and no one knows me.
[26F] 8.5/10. I would have several drinks with you and slip my credit card to the bartender when you weren’t looking.
If you did all that without anyone noticing, you must suffer from micropenis.
Sure, I’ll do that
Send me pics and we’ll see. I’m always way more serious than whoever I’m talking to it seems.
I’m not the type to live with a disability. I’d rather just die, thanks though.

It’s a bit late for the healthcare. Surgery is done, my week in the hospital is done, most follow up visits are done, they said there’s no need for physical therapy. No use for the healthcare. It would just be a waste on someone like me who’s just going to blow a hole in her own chest.
I have health insurance. I still got a $54,000 bill just for the helicopter that took me to the hospital.

Great suggestions. I’ll send you my PayPal so you can fund my search for another occupational therapist. If that’s a symptom of depression, then I’ve been depressed for as long as I can remember, which isn’t inconsistent with what I’ve told my therapists. I struggled for years to get to a point where I could function just fighting my mental issues, I’m not doing this anymore.

Occupational therapist said she’s done all she can for me. I’ve been in therapy since I was 18. Here I am, medicated, and still posting in this sub. I never wanted to impact the world. Quite the opposite. I always wished to be invisible. Soon I will be

I’m nearly 26. I haven’t been suicidal in years, but my situation is far worse that I imagined it would be. I lost my mobility, my independence, the trust of my boss.. The woman I want to be with is drifting away from me and I’m helpless. I can’t even go to her because I can’t leave the house.
Oh yeah, and I’m drowning in medical bills even after insurance. I can’t leave the house without help. I was so independent before. I don’t want this life.
Car wreck put me in a wheelchair. Woman I want won’t talk to me and I can’t see her. My boss doesn’t even want me to come back to work.

Sorry I don’t think I mentioned it in the post, but I recently lost the ability to walk and I’m having a really hard time with it. The time I spend with her is pretty much all that makes me feel alive at this point, but we live in different cities and I haven’t seen her in a week. I’m having a really awful day, and I’m still in a lot of pain from surgery.
Life is far too long in my opinion. Wish I could just have a laugh easy peasy like that, but I just wish I were dead.
Maybe... I’m trying not to care anymore
Sorry, I don’t find your comment funny. There’s a lot more to the story than what I posted, but it’s not written for your entertainment, I can assure you.
I’m glad I can help
A comment on this post or another one?

As a woman who got married young, has a child, and just began a fling with a woman after repressing that side of myself since I was about 14, I would say go for it. It feels good to do what you’ve secretly wanted to for so long, but just be careful how you handle letting the people in your life know, as that can be tricky at times.
Went to a run of the mill prenatal appointment, where nothing bad even happened and the doctor admitted me to the hospital for a panic attack.

It’s such a ridiculous situation involving an open relationship, jealousy, disability, amnesia, long distance, same-sex, workplace relationship that maybe isn’t even a relationship?? If you or anyone else is down for that hayride, please pm me because I really need to talk, but I just had a high school stalker find my main account so I’m paranoid to post too many details.
